unresolved_should_improve.claim: The first draft kept three turns: 'They had never got beyond 1815', 'one had even a little time to gloat over the repayment of old scores', and the 'British mind is the slowest' idea. The revision cut all three. The scores clause had prepared the 'personal score as cleared off' line in para 6.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The Times ridicule clause still motivates the 'score'. 'Thick cortex of fixed ideas' and 'senile from youth' keep some of the satiric edge.

evidence.quote: for the British mind is the slowest of all minds, as the files of the Times proved
Englishmen were not quick to see their blunders, and one had even a little time to gloat over the repayment of old scores.
They had never got beyond 1815.
The capture of Vicksburg had not yet penetrated Delane's thick cortex of fixed ideas.
assured him that he regarded his own personal score as cleared off

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore 'one had even a little time to gloat over the repayment of old scores' before the Milnes news, and 'They had never got beyond 1815.'
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: These are not protected text, but the voice profile emphasizes aphorism and deflation; this is an optional tradeoff the revision took too far.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The narrator's concrete-to-aphorism movement, which the voice profile names, flattens. The 'score' metaphor in the Delane passage arrives without its preparation.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Revision strips the aphoristic, deflating turns around Russell and Delane, including the 'old scores' setup

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision deleted three retrospective markers: 'remained secret for some five-and-twenty years', 'Not until long after Earl Russell's death was the question reopened', and the first draft's line that the Minister would have used no stronger language had he known of the October 1862 betrayal.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The dates still mark 1889 as the later source, and 'forty years after' survives in para 20.

evidence.quote: secret--and remained secret for some five-and-twenty years--his animus
His hostile activity of 1862 was still secret--and remained secret for some five-and-twenty years--but his animus
His hostile activity of 1862 was still secret, but his animus seemed made clear
Not until long after Earl Russell's death was the question reopened.
Russell had quitted office in 1866; he died in 1878; his biography was published in 1889.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the dash clause '--and remained secret for some five-and-twenty years--' in para 9.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: This supports the continuity check to mark the 1889 biography clearly; it is a small loss against the voice profile's dual-perspective requirement.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The 1863 judgment and the 1900s retrospect are less clearly set side by side. The father's ignorance and the forty-year delay in the evidence carry less of the irony.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Retrospective markers of hidden knowledge removed

unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision dropped the sentence saying he would never again find education to compare with this 'racked and thumb-screwed' struggle. It substituted a flat 'The struggle's practical value'.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: 'Life never could know more than a single such climax' in para 4 partly carries the idea.

evidence.quote: he would never again find education to compare with the life-and-death alternative of this two-year-and-a-half struggle in London
He would never again find education to compare with this two-year-and-a-half struggle in London, as it had racked and thumb-screwed him in its shifting phases
The struggle's practical value as education turned on his correctness of judgment in measuring the men and their forces.
They rendered worthless his whole painful diplomatic experience.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's sentence before 'but its practical value as education turned on...'.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: Optional tradeoff; the plan's essential 'whole diplomatic education is rendered worthless' depends on it.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The retrospect's verdict, 'rendered worthless his whole painful diplomatic experience', loses the explicit high point it overturns. The ironic reversal is less sharp.
unresolved_should_improve.title: The claimed peak of education is cut, weakening its later collapse

unresolved_should_improve.claim: Two pieces of the legal argument were cut. One is that Russell detained the ships 'not under the statute, but on the ground urged by the American Minister'. The other is that Palmerston found 'no lawful ground'. Without them, 'his opponent's ground' has no stated content and the buying suggestion appears unmotivated.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The Solicitor General's 'policy though not of strict law' and the Lairds' reliance on the law officers survive, so the gist is inferable.

evidence.quote: under the statute, but on the ground urged by the American Minister, of international obligation above the statute.
On consulting the law officers he found that there was no lawful ground for meddling with the ironclads
Palmerston met the appeal with wonderful loyalty, and suggested buying the ships for the British Navy.
This sudden leap to his opponent's ground might have roused Palmerston to inhuman scorn, but Palmerston met the appeal with wonderful loyalty, and suggested buying the ships for the British Navy.

unresolved_should_improve.minimal_repair: After 'detained', add 'not under the statute, but on the ground urged by the American Minister'. Insert 'finding no lawful ground for meddling,' before 'suggested buying'.
unresolved_should_improve.plan_relation: The plan requires 'detaining the ships as policy, not law; Palmerston's loyal suggestion'. Both are kept in skeleton form.
unresolved_should_improve.reader_effect: The evidence chain that converts Russell from conspirator to muddler is harder to follow. The Palmerston-as-proof-of-negligence point is lost.
unresolved_should_improve.title: Legal mechanism dropped, so the 'opponent's ground' and the purchase plan are under-motivated
